crossRefs.note: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.
The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.
though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

translations.web: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
translations.bsb: If he is uprooted from his place, it will disown him, saying, ‘I never saw you.’
translations.kjv: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen
translations.asv: If he be destroyed from his place, Then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
